prompts.instructions: intake is active. When assigned an intake, read its instructions at resource metaform://intake/procedure, with metaform intake prompt, or the intake tool's prompt command, and follow the procedure it serves. The forms it records are at resource metaform://intake/schema. The recording commands are start, then element and join as reasoned, show to read back, and finish; their arguments are in the intake tool's schema, or read metaform help intake.
prompts.no_intake: This project has no intake. Nothing else in Metaform works until it is done. Tell the person, in words like these: "Since this is the first time running the system here, I'm going to do a basic analysis of the project. When it's done we can go through it together with some Q&A. If that's all right, I'll start the web GUI so you can watch the process in real time. It opens on this machine only; that can be changed later, just ask. Ready for me to start?" When they say yes: call web with command start. It returns the address the GUI runs at; give that to the person. If it returns an error, say so and stop. Once it is running, start the intake: read resource metaform://intake/procedure and resource metaform://intake/schema, start a subagent with both, and have it perform the intake with the intake tool: start, then element and join as it reasons, show to check, finish. The person follows it live in the web GUI. When it finishes, say so and invite their questions.
prompts.unfinished: An intake was started but aborted and still remains to be completed.

element.namespace_address: Element: any nameable part, considered as a type. Nameable ≠ notable. Entity: a whole made of elements; scope-relative (zooming into an element makes it an entity). AT: Artifact Type — anneals same-type AUEs into a type.
element.role: AUE: entity being examined, created, or used (any medium; one or many). Asset status depends on use. CQU: Cestui Que Use — the explicit RE which benefits from and drives the improvements on the artifact. Recorded under {CQU_BASE}. DE: Defining Element — loss changes the AUE's type; serves an external CQU's OP; names the AUE's functional type independent of medium, encoding, genre, style. SE: Substantial Element — EF helps the DE serve the CQU's OP (even if subversive, weak, replaceable). NE: Notable Element — states an essential external demand or dependency.
element.name: name

join.receiver: RE: Receiving Element/Entity — the element bearing an OP; its joins live in it. Join: purpose record living in the RE (see SCHEMA_JOIN).
join.elements: PE: Providing Element — join endpoint whose EF fulfills the OP.
join.provider: PE: Providing Element — join endpoint whose EF fulfills the OP.
join.purpose: OP: Operative Purpose — the WHY; the RE's reason for the encounter.
join.ef: EF: see {LB_EF} — the HOW; what the PE does, in active voice; recorded in the RE's join.
join.ifd: IFD: Information Flow Direction — the primary flow of information: sends (OP->EF) | receives (EF->OP) | both (equal need).
